title: Yevanda
desc: A young man working as a collection agent for a bank discovers that a couple are conning gullible people out of their money. He decides to give them a taste of their own medicine and falls in love.

title: Deja Vu
desc: An undercover police inspector investigates a mysterious abduction case of the daughter of the director general of police of a state which bears similarity with the description of a crime novelist.

title: Panchamugi
desc: Panchamukhi, a wife and mother, leaves her family devastated when she dies according to a prophecy by Goddess Durga. However, her grieving husband encounters an exact lookalike of her in the city.

title: Mandela
desc: In a small village, two political parties compete in the local elections and are ready to win at any cost. In a twist of fate, the single deciding vote comes down to a small-time barber.

title: Manam
desc: Bittu, a six-year-old, loses his parents in an unfortunate car accident. Thirty years later, he comes across two collegians who look exactly like his late parents' young selves.

title: Avan Ivan
desc: A benevolent landlord embraces two half-brothers as his chosen family, nurturing their dreams, but their lives take a perilous turn when they cross paths with a notorious cattle smuggler.

title: Veera Simha Reddy
desc: Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.
